generator_cmd: python3 -I -c "import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'tools/pyciphers');from secretpy import Scytale as S;print(S().encrypt(sys.argv[1],3),end='')" "$plain" | rev  # secretpy Scytale.encrypt(text, 3), then rev
